qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r13/raw-evidence-index.json (all 16 scripted-golden artifact hashes and the hosted reward.json hash recomputed and matching)

Own bounded live run: frozen solution installed with solve.sh in a private container from image cw-editor-agent-r3, launched as tests/test.sh does, driven with Playwright from cw-editor-verifier:current; container removed afterwards
evidence: Walked all 3 gate, 42 Functional, 6 Polish and 3 Visual criteria against the frozen golden source and found no criterion the reference cannot satisfy. The task has no seeded figures, ordering or arithmetic to mismatch (seed_data.json holds no user snippets; every fixture is chosen by the judge). Frozen task tree is byte-identical to projects/colderwater-playground-devtools (diff -rq empty), so the scripted results apply to these bytes. Scripted golden results (hashes verified): editor.json 21/21, runtime.json 15/15 (14 Functional + render gate), persist-before/after 7 Functional + cw_shared_saved_record with a real pid-changing restart, polish.json 6/6 + cw_custom_document_surface, pageErrors [] in every suite. Source mapping for the criteria changed since the hosted run: cw_basic_run_output (runtime.ts buildRun/PreviewRunner.run, app.tsx log); document jump keys (custom-editor.js:281 'home'/'end' -> moveCaret(...,true) and revealCaret); restore replay (app.tsx 'Retry same restore' resends the stored request, server.js:102-106 returns the stored result for a repeated operationId without a new revision); stale-save order (server.js:56-57 REVISION_CONFLICT 409, app.tsx save() catch leaves title, filename and code untouched); Save focus (app.tsx save(): editor.current?.focus() before and after the request); inline handlers (runtime.ts:334-342 converts on* attributes to listeners; CSP adds script-src-attr 'unsafe-inline'). Own live run on the frozen bytes with judge-style fixtures typed by real key presses, different from the scripted fixtures, all satisfied their criteria: sum via textContent, document.write and template literal ('579' then edited rerun, '975', '333' in preview and console); HTML preview with onclick="change()" global function and with this.textContent; HTML throw reported 'HTML-BOOM-77 · line 11' counted from the file; JS throw 'JS-BOOM-44 · line 4'; syntax-error run 'Unexpected token (1:21) · line 1' with draft unchanged; handled-rejection control 'Complete', Promise.reject 'REJ-THREE · line 3', async throw after await null and after an awaited timer '· line 4'; three-way timer/interval/Promise control then Stop ('Run stopped', second marker never appeared in 8 s, control picture kept); newer Run superseding a 4 s timer ('Previous run cancelled', old marker never appeared); fresh interaction budget with inline handlers (ONE-DONE after 1 s, then 'Execution stopped: five-second time limit'); last-good restore kept input value 'TYPED-VAL' and canvas pixel [255,0,0,255] and a later Run worked; while(true){} and self-rescheduling timer both ended with the time-limit reason and restored 'CTRL-PIC'; eval (bare and inside try/catch), Function, WebAssembly.instantiate and Module, Worker from blob and data URL, and import() each refused with a visible reason and no payload marker while the strings/comments control logged normally; isolation probes each logged a failure line, both no-cors fetches rejected, page title and localStorage entry unchanged; HTML and JS Format gave two-space nesting, same rendered result, 'Already formatted.' on the second pass, exact one-step Undo and Redo; five distinct JS token treatments (function name identical at declaration and call, all different from plain rgb(216,229,243)) and four distinct HTML treatments; at 390 px scrollWidth 390 and preview text shown; emoji plus combining accent copied from Find with real Ctrl+C and pasted into the editor with real Ctrl+V, one Backspace removed the whole emoji and Undo restored it. No page errors. Risk stays true because required runtime evidence is missing for these bytes: no configured claude-code judge run exists on this candidate, so the three Visual likert criteria and the judge's own handling of the 51 binary criteria are unmeasured here; the only judge measurement (Oracle 0.9833, Functional 41/41, Polish 6/6, Visual 0.9167) is on an earlier candidate with a different criterion set and golden, and the scripted and own runs used the agent image rather than tests/test.sh in the verifier image. No Oracle score is claimed for these bytes.
